title: EventDef
description: K'UHUL semantic event contract. @kind must be semantic.event.v1. Observed and Reported are valid ingestion states. Inferred and Disputed are earned states — parse() rejects both (Pattern Induction Guard: earned status cannot be self-declared at ingestion). When @epistemic_status is absent, defaults to Reported. predicate must be declared in the live RelationRegistry. subject_type and object_type are optional wildcards; when provided, they are validated against the relation's declared domain/range.

@subject.description: Entity about which this event is recorded.

@subject_type.description: Optional entity type for the subject. When provided, validated against the relation's declared domain.

@predicate.description: Event verb. Must be declared in the RelationRegistry at parse time.

@object.description: Outcome or effect of the event.

@object_type.description: Optional entity type for the object. When provided, validated against the relation's declared range.

@timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the event occurred.

@epistemic_status.description: How the event is known. Observed and Reported are valid ingestion states. Inferred and Disputed are earned — rejected at parse (Pattern Induction Guard).
